requirementIndex.title: WHEN the app renders THE SYSTEM SHALL display a badge showing the application version prefixed with `v` (e.g. `v0.0.0`).
THE SYSTEM SHALL derive the displayed version from the `version` field of `package.json`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL render the version text as a plain, unmodified text node (no truncation, no additional formatting beyond the `v` prefix).

WHEN the application is built or the dev server starts THE SYSTEM SHALL inject the version string into the client bundle via Vite's `define` config option under the global identifier `__APP_VERSION__`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL read `package.json`'s `version` field via a static `import` in `vite.config.ts` at config-load time.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT perform a runtime `fetch` or dynamic `import()` of `package.json` to obtain the version.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT require any change to `resolveJsonModule` in `tsconfig.app.json`.

THE SYSTEM SHALL limit modification of `vite.config.ts` to adding the `define: { __APP_VERSION__: JSON.stringify(pkg.version) }` entry (and the static `import` of `package.json` needed to support it), leaving the existing `react()`/`tailwindcss()` plugin list, `resolve.alias` configuration, and all other existing config entries unmodified.
WHEN TypeScript compiles code that references `__APP_VERSION__` THE SYSTEM SHALL provide an ambient declaration of `__APP_VERSION__: string` in `src/vite-env.d.ts`.
IF `src/vite-env.d.ts` does not already exist THE SYSTEM SHALL create it as a new file including a `/// <reference types="vite/client" />` directive alongside the `__APP_VERSION__` declaration.
THE SYSTEM SHALL implement the badge as a component named `FooterVersionBadge` at `src/components/footer-version-badge/footer-version-badge.tsx`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL implement `FooterVersionBadge` with no props and no internal state.
THE SYSTEM SHALL treat `src/components/footer-version-badge/` as exclusively owned by this feature, adding no unrelated files to that directory.
WHEN the app root renders THE SYSTEM SHALL mount `<FooterVersionBadge />` exactly once, from `src/App.tsx`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL mount `<FooterVersionBadge />` alongside the existing `<CommandPalette />` mount without making other markup changes to `src/App.tsx`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT mount `FooterVersionBadge` from any file other than `src/App.tsx`.
WHERE the badge is displayed THE SYSTEM SHALL position it `fixed` to the bottom-right corner of the viewport with a 12px offset from the right and bottom edges (`right-3 bottom-3`).
THE SYSTEM SHALL render the badge as a pill/chip shape using rounded-full styling, a border, and a background color derived from the existing `--code-bg` CSS custom property.
THE SYSTEM SHALL render the badge text using small font sizing (`text-xs`) and a color derived from the existing `--text` CSS custom property.

THE SYSTEM SHALL style the badge using Tailwind arbitrary-value syntax that references the existing hand-rolled CSS custom properties (`--border`, `--code-bg`, `--text`) rather than introducing new design tokens.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT set an explicit `z-index` on the badge or its wrapper.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT add a Shadcn semantic token set (e.g. `--background`, `--foreground`, `--muted-foreground`, or any `@theme` block) to `src/index.css` or `tailwind.config.ts`.
WHEN the page is printed THE SYSTEM SHALL hide the badge via `print:hidden` applied to its outer wrapper element.
THE SYSTEM SHALL render the badge with no click handlers, no `<a>`/`<Link>` elements, and no clipboard-copy behavior.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT apply `aria-hidden` to the badge or its text.
THE SYSTEM SHALL expose the version text as plain, screen-reader-visible text, reachable like any other static text on the page.
WHEN the app runs in either a development build or a production build THE SYSTEM SHALL render the badge unconditionally with identical markup.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT gate rendering of the badge using `import.meta.env.DEV` or `import.meta.env.PROD`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT expose any props on `FooterVersionBadge`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT introduce any new settings, context, or store entry to configure the badge.
THE SYSTEM SHALL implement this feature using only `react` (an existing dependency) and Tailwind utility classes, adding no new npm package.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT modify `src/index.css`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `components.json`, `App.css`, or any file under `src/assets/*` as part of this feature.

THE SYSTEM SHALL limit the total set of touched/created files to `src/components/footer-version-badge/footer-version-badge.tsx` (created, owned), `src/vite-env.d.ts` (created if absent, bootstrapped), `vite.config.ts` (touched per Requirement 2), and `src/App.tsx` (touched per Requirement 5), with no other file added or modified.
